name: LITTLE LOVER
source:
There are two visual novel pieces in the package:
One is Naruto story about getting a teacher
The other one is memory loss kinetic mini-novel.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作包含两部视觉小说：
一部是关于寻找老师的《火影忍者》故事；
另一部是关于失忆的动感小说小品。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
